unverified_paths: P2-D01, the landing race: the legacy poller can copy a half-written .dat, the target lands atomically. The differing case cannot be exercised against pinned inputs, so parity is proven only for whole files.

Residual source-side race: the landing task requires the source to be unchanged across a one-second window spanning the read (stat, wait, read, stat) and refuses to publish anything that moved, but a producer that pauses longer than the stability window defeats that check exactly as it defeats the legacy 1-second double-stat. Closing it needs an upstream rename-on-complete or completion marker, which is D3-01 at STOP E. Not exercised by the pinned fixtures.
SFTP transport itself: the unit reconciles what is in the landing volume. The hop from the MVSPROD CB77340 drop to the volume is out of scope until D3-01 is decided at STOP E.
Structure parity: the harness compares rows, not Delta table properties, clustering, grants or comments. Nothing checks that ow_tp.bronze grants match any legacy access model.

factory-doctor source_principal_read_only: no privilege query is implemented for a Databricks-family source, and pipeline 2's source is files on disk, so SELECT-only access is asserted by construction rather than machine-verified.
Timestamps: ingested_at and file_modified_at are target-side metadata with no legacy counterpart and are excluded from the keyed diff.
